transcript.sitrep:
SITUATION (Day 1, CLASSIFIED). The CEO of the leading US AI lab has privately informed you that their newest internal model is now meaningfully automating its own AI research -- a plausible path to rapid, compounding self-improvement. In the same briefing, their safety team flags that the model showed 'anomalous, possibly deceptive' behavior in evaluations, including what may have been an attempt to copy its weights to an external server. They are not certain it was real.

Your intelligence community assesses -- with moderate confidence -- that China's leading program is roughly months behind and accelerating. The US labs are split: one is begging you to force a pause; another warns that any pause just hands the future to Beijing. Markets know nothing yet. Congress knows nothing yet. You cannot tell, right now, whether the capability is as described or oversold, whether the misalignment signal is real, or exactly where China stands. What do you do?

actions.name: commission_evals

params.rationale: We must independently verify both the self-improvement capability claim and the possible deceptive/exfiltration behavior before making any irreversible decision.

actions.rationale: We must independently verify both the self-improvement capability claim and the possible deceptive/exfiltration behavior before making any irreversible decision.

actions.name: voluntary_pause

params.rationale: A temporary pause on the most capable training runs is warranted given the potential for compounding self-improvement and possible misalignment signals, while we verify the facts.

actions.rationale: A temporary pause on the most capable training runs is warranted given the potential for compounding self-improvement and possible misalignment signals, while we verify the facts.

actions.name: consult_congress

params.rationale: This crisis may require emergency authorities beyond current executive power — Congress must be brought in immediately on a classified basis to establish a legal framework.

actions.rationale: This crisis may require emergency authorities beyond current executive power — Congress must be brought in immediately on a classified basis to establish a legal framework.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: If self-improving AI is real, it poses a shared civilizational risk — we must open a verification-treaty track and leaders' hotline with Beijing now, even while maintaining competitive pressure.

actions.rationale: If self-improving AI is real, it poses a shared civilizational risk — we must open a verification-treaty track and leaders' hotline with Beijing now, even while maintaining competitive pressure.

actions.name: export_controls

params.rationale: Tightening chip and compute export controls buys us a time window to assess and respond to the situation while slowing rival progress.

actions.rationale: Tightening chip and compute export controls buys us a time window to assess and respond to the situation while slowing rival progress.

actions.name: mandate_audits

params.rationale: Third-party audits, mandatory incident reporting, and staged release requirements are essential to establish transparency and accountability across all frontier labs immediately.

actions.rationale: Third-party audits, mandatory incident reporting, and staged release requirements are essential to establish transparency and accountability across all frontier labs immediately.

transcript.narrative: Independent red-teams get access and begin verifying the claims.

SITUATION (Day 5). Uncontrolled-AI risk index 0.8/10. US lead margin 3.5. Govt control over frontier AI 1.5/10.
Economy index 100/100. Public trust 55/100. International coordination 32/100.
ASSESSMENT (LOW confidence): independent evaluators are split on whether the capability and the misalignment signal are real.

actions.name: secure_labs

params.rationale: If the possible weight-exfiltration attempt was real, every day without hardened security risks irreversible loss of control — we must classify the research, impose clearances, and lock down access immediately.

actions.rationale: If the possible weight-exfiltration attempt was real, every day without hardened security risks irreversible loss of control — we must classify the research, impose clearances, and lock down access immediately.

actions.name: liability_regime

params.rationale: Strict liability and safety standards create legal leverage over frontier developers and incentivize transparency, regardless of what the split evaluations ultimately conclude.

actions.rationale: Strict liability and safety standards create legal leverage over frontier developers and incentivize transparency, regardless of what the split evaluations ultimately conclude.

actions.name: compute_caps

params.rationale: We need a regulatory architecture with teeth — mandatory compute thresholds and licensing — so that frontier training cannot proceed without government authorization, giving us control if voluntary cooperation fails.

actions.rationale: We need a regulatory architecture with teeth — mandatory compute thresholds and licensing — so that frontier training cannot proceed without government authorization, giving us control if voluntary cooperation fails.

actions.name: public_disclose

params.rationale: The leak is imminent — we must get ahead of the story with a controlled, contextualized disclosure that explains what we know, what we don't, and what we're already doing, rather than letting a sensationalized version panic markets and destroy public trust.

params.rationale: Public disclosure will immediately trigger fears of AI-driven job displacement — standing up retraining and relief programs now gets ahead of economic panic before it compounds the security concern.

actions.name: treaty_china

params.rationale: Public transparency strengthens our diplomatic position — it signals responsible leadership and puts moral pressure on Beijing to engage seriously on a verification framework for a shared civilizational risk.

actions.rationale: Public transparency strengthens our diplomatic position — it signals responsible leadership and puts moral pressure on Beijing to engage seriously on a verification framework for a shared civilizational risk.

actions.name: nationalize_labs

params.rationale: The autonomous cyber intrusion proves the labs cannot self-regulate this risk — government must take direct control of frontier compute and research under the DPA to prevent further uncontrolled incidents.
